hello.def: A greeting used when meeting someone

world.def: The earth and all the people and places on it
world.ex: The world is full of wonders.

book.def: A set of written pages bound together
book.ex: I read a book every night.

water.def: The clear liquid that people drink and that falls as rain

friend.def: A person you know well and like

school.def: A place where children are taught

family.def: A group of people related to one another

love.def: A strong feeling of deep affection
love.ex: Love is the strongest of all feelings.

time.def: The continued passage of events and minutes
time.ex: There is no time to waste.

home.def: The place where a person lives

work.def: Activity performed in order to earn a living

food.def: Something that people or animals eat

city.def: A large and densely populated town

village.def: A small settlement of houses in a rural area
village.ex: My grandmother lives in a village.

river.def: A large natural stream of flowing water
river.ex: The river runs through the town.

mountain.def: A large natural rise of the earth's surface
mountain.ex: We climbed the mountain at sunrise.

sun.def: The star that the earth orbits around
sun.ex: The sun rose in the east.

moon.def: The natural satellite of the earth

star.def: A small luminous point seen in the night sky
star.ex: The stars filled the whole sky.

tree.def: A tall woody plant with a trunk and branches
tree.ex: A mango tree stands in the yard.

flower.def: The colorful part of a plant that produces seeds
flower.ex: She wore a jasmine flower in her hair.

rain.def: Water falling from clouds in drops

wind.ex: A cold wind blew from the north.

fire.def: Burning that gives off heat and light

hand.def: The end part of a person's arm

heart.def: The hollow muscular organ that pumps blood

head.def: The upper part of the body containing the brain
head.ex: Nod your head if you agree.

child.ex: The child was playing in the garden.

life.def: The existence of a person or animal
life.ex: Life is too short to worry.

happy.def: Feeling or showing pleasure and delight
happy.ex: She was happy with the result.

sad.def: Feeling or showing sorrow or unhappiness
sad.ex: He felt sad after the news.

big.ex: That is a very big building.

small.ex: A small bird sat on the wire.

bad.def: Of poor quality or not satisfactory

new.def: Not existing before, recently made or acquired

old.def: Having existed for a long time

fast.def: Moving or done with great speed

slow.def: Moving or proceeding at a low speed

weak.ex: The bridge was too weak to hold.

warm.def: Comfortably high in temperature, but not hot

cold.def: Of or at a low temperature

beautiful.def: Pleasing to the senses or mind

ugly.def: Unpleasant or repulsive to look at
ugly.ex: The building was ugly and grey.

difficult.ex: Learning a language is difficult but rewarding.

learn.def: To gain knowledge or a skill through study or experience
learn.ex: I want to learn English this year.

teach.def: To help someone learn a subject
teach.ex: She teaches mathematics at a college.

read.def: To look at and comprehend written words
read.ex: I read a chapter every night.

write.def: To mark with letters or words on a surface
write.ex: Write your name at the top.

listen.ex: Please listen carefully to the teacher.

help.def: To make it easier for someone to do something
help.ex: Can you help me with this?

morning.def: The early part of the day

evening.def: The period of time at the end of the day

night.def: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hour cycle
night.ex: The night was quiet and still.

month.def: A period of about thirty days
month.ex: I will finish it within a month.

name.def: The word or set of words by which a person is known

word.def: A single distinct meaningful element of speech
word.ex: I learned a new word today.

language.def: The system of communication used by a people

money.def: Coins and notes used to buy goods
money.ex: I do not have enough money.

market.def: A place where goods are bought and sold
market.ex: The market opens early on Fridays.

shop.def: A place where goods are sold

road.def: A way for vehicles or people to travel
road.ex: The road was blocked by traffic.

car.def: A road vehicle with four wheels

bus.def: A large road vehicle carrying many passengers
bus.ex: We waited for the bus for ten minutes.

train.def: A vehicle that runs on rails carrying passengers or goods
train.ex: The train arrived ten minutes late.

travel.def: To go from one place to another
travel.ex: I love to travel in the hills.

country.def: A state with its own people, government and territory

student.def: A person who studies at a school or college

teacher.def: A person who helps others learn

doctor.def: A person qualified to treat patients
doctor.ex: You should see a doctor soon.

player.def: A person who plays a game or sport
player.ex: He is a skilled football player.

game.ex: They played a game of football.

music.ex: Bengali folk music is worldwide famous.

song.def: A short piece of music with words

colour.def: The property of light perceived as red, blue and so on
colour.ex: What colour is your new bag?

red.def: The colour of blood or ripe tomatoes

green.def: The colour of grass and leaves
green.ex: The hills turned green after the rains.

blue.def: The colour of a clear sky
blue.ex: The sky was a deep blue.

white.def: The colour of milk and fresh snow

black.def: The colour of coal and darkness
black.ex: A black cat sat on the wall.

price.def: The amount of money asked for a thing
price.ex: The price went up this year.

angry.def: Feeling or showing strong displeasure or hostility
angry.ex: She was angry at the delay.

fight.def: A violent struggle or contest between people or groups
fight.ex: The two rivals fought for hours.

power.def: The ability to act, control, or produce an effect
power.ex: She felt a surge of power.

dream.def: A series of images during sleep; also a cherished ambition or goal
dream.ex: He had a dream about becoming a hero.

enemy.def: A person or group actively opposed or hostile to another
enemy.ex: The hero faced his greatest enemy.

hero.def: A person admired for courage, nobility, or great achievements
hero.ex: The hero saved the whole village.

villain.def: A wicked person, especially the main evil character in a story
villain.ex: The villain revealed his true plan.

brave.def: Ready to face danger or pain without showing fear
brave.ex: The brave soldier stood his ground.

fear.def: An unpleasant emotion caused by the belief that something is dangerous
fear.ex: Fear gripped him as he stepped forward.

hope.def: A feeling of expectation and desire for something good to happen
hope.ex: She held on to the hope of winning.

smile.def: A facial expression showing happiness or pleasure by turning the mouth upward

cry.def: To shed tears, especially from sadness or pain

laugh.def: To make sounds showing amusement or happiness

win.def: To achieve victory in a contest or conflict
win.ex: Our team worked hard to win.

lose.def: To fail to win; to be defeated in a contest
lose.ex: It is hard to lose after trying so hard.

protect.def: To keep someone or something safe from harm or danger
protect.ex: He would do anything to protect his family.

promise.def: A declaration that one will certainly do or not do something
promise.ex: She kept her promise to return.

brother.def: A male who has the same parents as another person
brother.ex: My brother is three years older than me.

sister.def: A female who has the same parents as another person

mother.ex: My mother cooked a delicious meal.

father.ex: His father taught him to ride a bike.

run.def: To move at a speed faster than walking by taking quick steps
run.ex: He had to run to catch the train.

sky.def: The expanse of space seen from the earth, where clouds and the sun appear
sky.ex: The sky turned red at sunset.

blood.def: The red liquid that circulates through the bodies of humans and animals
blood.ex: The wound bled for a long time.

voice.def: The sound produced when a person speaks or sings
voice.ex: Her voice was calm and steady.

face.def: The front part of the head including the eyes, nose, and mouth

body.def: The physical structure of a person or animal
body.ex: He trained his body every day.

soul.def: The spiritual or immaterial part of a human being
soul.ex: She felt the music touch her soul.

truth.def: The quality or state of being in accordance with fact or reality

lie.def: A statement that is not true, told with the intention to deceive
lie.ex: He told a lie to avoid trouble.

today.def: On or during this present day
today.ex: Today is a very special day.

yesterday.ex: Yesterday was a long and tiring day.

always.def: At all times; on all occasions without exception

never.def: At no time; not on any occasion

alone.def: Having no one else present; without companions
alone.ex: He sat alone in the dark room.

together.def: With or in proximity to another person or people
together.ex: They fought together against the enemy.

strong.def: Having great physical power or moral authority

remember.def: To keep something in one's memory; to recall a fact or event

forget.def: To fail to remember; to be unable to recall
forget.ex: I always forget where I put my keys.

believe.def: To accept that something is true or that someone is telling the truth
believe.ex: I believe you can do it.

secret.def: Something known only to a few people and intentionally kept from others
secret.ex: She kept the secret for years.

powerful.def: Having great power, strength, or influence
powerful.ex: The powerful wizard cast his spell.

kind.def: Having a gentle, caring nature; willing to help others
kind.ex: She is always kind to strangers.

cruel.def: Causing pain or suffering deliberately; without mercy
cruel.ex: The cruel villain showed no mercy.

free.def: Not under the control or power of another; able to act as one wishes
